questions.question: Please identify the source of the legend about al-Khwarizmi’s wife and his missed lunch. The post names two works by O’Connor and Robertson without pages or links. The confirmed university article https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/HistTopics/Arabic_mathematics/ explains al-Khwarizmi’s contribution, but the anecdote’s connection to the named works has not been established. Please agree a source or an editorial description of the joke; the legend and original bibliography are retained.
